An individual financial document, transaction, obligation, allocation or reporting record. The sole financial node label; recordType distinguishes its nature. BOQ remains independent. Legacy Payment records reconcile to recordType=Payment while preserving IDs and provenance.

name: id
description: Unique stable identifier of the FinancialRecord. Preserve confirmed existing IDs during reconciliation and migration.

name: recordType
description: Required financial record type. All listed types use this single node label; BOQ remains separate.

name: referenceNumber
description: Financial record reference exactly as printed; preserve leading zeros.

name: referenceNumberNorm
description: referenceNumber upper-cased with only ASCII A-Z and 0-9 retained.

name: description
description: Source-supported description of the individual financial record.

name: category
description: Financial classification of the record, distinct from recordType.

name: amount
description: Primary source-reported monetary amount according to recordType. Preserve the distinction between invoiced, paid, incurred and allocated amounts.

name: currency
description: Explicit valid uppercase ISO 4217 currency code.

name: taxAmount
description: Tax amount when applicable and explicitly evidenced.

name: includesVAT
description: Whether the relevant amount includes VAT, only when evidenced; unstated remains unknown.

name: status
description: Source-supported financial record status; no closed enum is specified.

name: effectiveDate
description: Date of the relevant financial event, e.g. invoice issue, payment, expense or payroll date.

name: dueDate
description: Due date of the financial obligation, when applicable and evidenced.

name: periodStart
description: Start of the applicable financial or reporting period.

name: periodEnd
description: End of the applicable financial or reporting period.

name: paymentMethod
description: Source-supported payment method, when applicable.

name: transactionReference
description: Source transaction reference exactly as recorded.

name: interimNumber
description: Interim payment sequence number when applicable; at least 1.

name: paymentTerms
description: Source-supported payment terms, when applicable.

name: grossAmount
description: Explicit gross amount, kept distinct from primary and net amounts.

name: netAmount
description: Explicit net amount, kept distinct from primary and gross amounts.

name: deductions
description: Source-supported deductions when applicable.

name: costType
description: Source-supported cost type, when applicable.

name: costCenter
description: Source-supported cost center, when applicable.

name: fiscalYear
description: Financial year as a lossless integer, when evidenced.

name: revisedAmount
description: Revised amount when explicitly evidenced, distinct from the original amount.

name: adjustmentReason
description: Source-supported reason for the financial adjustment.

name: statementType
description: Source-supported financial statement type, when applicable.

name: summary
description: Factual summary specific to this record identity, type, purpose, amount, parties and dates. Persist only with its matching complete 1536-float summaryEmbedding.

name: summaryEmbedding
description: Complete 1536-float, finite, nonzero embedding of the exact summary text using text-embedding-3-small; persist the pair together.

name: sourceUrl
description: Genuine original source provenance; not searched.

name: sourceUrl
